The three of us loitered in the road, killing time. Early yet, but every place nearby was a tavern where minors were not admitted. Students, ordinarily, were not a welcome addition.

But this wasn't the real pleasure district down by the bay. Most customers were uncles coming off a job at the nearby factories or building sites. Money, basically, they did not have. The shops were simple, therefore; the unwholesomeness was also modest.

Plenty of familiar faces passed. Most called out to us; none scolded us. Probably they knew students being present did not actually cause trouble in this particular street.

Trouble here meant, at most, one drunk fighting another. Peaceful arrangement.

Except.

Consider it properly. Their living came from troubling people.

Trouble supplied to public, livelihood supplied to you. In between, where is the social contribution hiding?

Professional drinking, compared with that, was positively realistic.

So first remove the word business. Troubling people was their biological habit. Nobody was doing a job here; nature was proceeding. Haan, now the unreasonable part disappeared.

Shoving pedestrians, distributing tobacco breath without a break, kicking rubbish for no reason—same as a stinkbug farting. That was how one had to understand it.

Getting angry at their behavior was wrong. As humanity, the highest order of life, we ought to watch these lower creatures with warmth. Study them. Surely there would be much to learn.

An attitude worthy of an intelligent species.

Muramasa《A difficult time, it seems, Mido.》
Kageaki"No. Nothing particular."
Muramasa《A blessing in disguise, perhaps. It seems you've parted from those children.》
Kageaki"Yes."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa《Mido? What is it? Something on your mind?》
Kageaki"A little. That soldier ant you encountered yesterday..."
Muramasa《Yes.》
Kageaki"If given an 'egg,' it could quite well know about us. I initially judged it had appeared to target you, but—"
Muramasa《You think otherwise?》
Kageaki"I cannot rule out that the targets were those students all along. Meeting and fighting you may merely have happened in the process."
Muramasa《...True. Watching for that was why I followed them in the first place.》
Kageaki"Perhaps it was hasty to exclude that possibility simply because the enemy was a parasite."
Muramasa《That parasite wanted only to abduct boys and girls, before and now, with no interest in us?》
Kageaki"That is also possible. Thinking back, more often than not, that one told the parasites almost nothing."
Muramasa《There were even cases where they didn't know they had been parasitized...》
Kageaki"Yes. In conclusion, I consider it dangerous to take our eyes completely off those three students."
Muramasa《Then... what shall we do? Divide the work?》
Kageaki"We need to."
Muramasa《Understood...》
